name: code-radius
description: Code Radius stops AI coding agents from editing before they know what a change will touch. Before any non-trivial feature, bugfix, rename, or migration, it produces a cited Impact Radius Report—entry points, callers, shared modules, contracts, tests, infra, and risks—plus a bounded edit set. Implement only inside that set; verify the diff afterward. No API keys. Portable Agent Skills for Cursor, ChatGPT/Codex, Copilot, VS Code, and Kiro.
